Relaying encrypted packets does not add anyone to your contacts.
Show your personal QR to a friend or send them your invitation code. You both confirm before chatting.
Turn on Mesh in network settings to exchange requests. Delivery waits until a route is available.
Check the fingerprint with your friend. Accepting allows both of you to chat and share profile photos.
Waiting for confirmation. Messages remain unavailable until your friend accepts.
No nearby profiles available. Both people must enable discovery to appear here.
No confirmed friends yet. Start with a QR invitation.
Your name and photo will be shared with this person in an encrypted request. They must accept before you can chat.
One use, valid for 24 hours. A new QR revokes the previous invitation. Share only with the intended person.
Send this link to a friend in another city. They will see the identity fingerprint and can start the chat only after confirming.
Saved. Requests will sync when a route is available.

Invalid, expired or mismatched device invitation.
